Recording linked to the bind transaction, the billing/commission entry, and the reinsurance cession record for the policy.
All policies with premium/commission/cession recorded in the current cycle plus a monthly 5% sample reconciled independently.
PASS = premium matches rating and billing, commission matches the producer agreement, and cession matches the treaty/facultative terms. FAIL = any mismatch across premium, commission or cession.
On FAIL, correct the entry (re-rate, fix commission rate, adjust cession) and re-reconcile before the accounting cutoff; the defect and fix are logged as an exception.
Field definitions: written_premium, commission_rate, commission_amount, treaty_id, ceded_share, ceded_premium — from the PolicyCenter/BillingCenter and reinsurance data dictionaries.
Control totals: recorded premium vs rating-engine premium vs billing entry reconciled to the cent; gross − ceded = net-retained checked per policy.

checklist.step: Record premium consistent with filed rates
checklist.value: Written premium recorded equals the rating-engine premium built from approved filed rates; deviations only where an authority-approved adjustment is documented.

testing.step: Reconcile recorded premium to rating
testing.value: Monthly 5% sample: recorded premium equals rating-engine premium to the cent; 0 unexplained variances.

checklist.step: Maintain an audit trail for premium, commission and cession entries
checklist.value: Each entry logs user, timestamp and source (rating worksheet, producer agreement, treaty); manual overrides carry a documented reason.

testing.step: Verify the financial audit trail and reconciliation
testing.value: Sampled policies show premium/commission/cession entries with a trail and a passing reconciliation (gross − ceded = net); 0 untracked entries.
